Nimisha Susan Varghese

HPE ARUBA GLOBAL ESCALATION ENGINEER

Address Bengaluru, India 560048

Phone +919845246202

E-mail nimishasusan19@gmail.com

Dynamic Network Engineer with over 7+ years of experience specializing in Aruba technologies, skilled in troubleshooting robust LAN/WAN solutions. Expertise in L2/L3 troubleshooting and a deep understanding of protocols such as OSPF, BGP, and TCP/IP ensure seamless network operations. Proven ability to conduct comprehensive network analysis and deliver exceptional customer support while effectively managing highly escalated situations. Committed to optimizing network performance and enhancing system reliability through innovative solutions and strategic problem- solving.

Skills

Network Tools Handled

Proficient in incident management and ticketing tools Like SFDC and JIRA .

Experienced with network monitoring and management platforms: Aruba Central,

SolarWinds , Netedit .

Skilled in packet analysis using Wireshark for troubleshooting and performance

optimization.

Hands-on experience with PuTTY for device configuration, remote access, and

diagnostics.

WORK EXPERIENCE

HPE ARUBA GLOBAL ESCALATION ENGINEER HPE, Bengaluru, India  Identify and resolve problems on high-end HPE switches.  Implementation and troubleshooting of VLAN, high availability solutions like

Oct 2018 - Current

VRRP, LACP, ACL, NAT, DHCP-related issues, etc.

Worked on Virtual Switching Extension (VSX), Virtual Switching Framework

(VSF).

Working knowledge of authentication protocols like TACACS, RADIUS,

802.1X, UBT, and GRE.

 Troubleshooting packet drop issues, latency issues, and spanning tree.

.

 Troubleshooting complex LAN/WAN infrastructure, including routing

protocols like OSPF and BGP.

Dealing with escalating problems and providing RCA for critical issues.  Have hands-on experience in handling highly critical network-down situations.

Managing Aruba Central, NETEDIT, Aruba Fabric Composer, and

troubleshooting the issues.

Recreate customer issues in the lab to provide faster resolution.  Resolved complex technical issues by analyzing system logs and collaborating with cross-functional teams, enhancing customer satisfaction.

Developed and implemented troubleshooting protocols for network and

software problems, significantly reducing resolution times.

Mentored junior engineers on best practices for incident management, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.  Optimized system performance by identifying and addressing recurring technical problems, resulting in improved service uptime.

Collaborated with product teams to provide feedback on system

functionalities, ensuring alignment with customer needs and service quality.
